description: Weather app showing metric and imperial units side by side in 8 languages maripànaTokana (Malagasy for "a single thermometer") is a weather app for Android. It shows every value in metric and imperial units side by side, so you never have to convert. It is also available as a web app at maripana.njarasoa.org, with nothing to install. Weather at a glance: • Main card: current condition, temperature (°C to one decimal place), today's low and high, rain or snow when it is coming, air quality when it is not good, and 4 tiles for the next 12 hours • Free-scroll layout: below the main card, all other cards are always open • Hourly and 10-day forecasts with tabs: Conditions, Precipitation, Wind, Pressure, UV and Air quality, each with an overview chart • Minutely nowcast when rain or snow is coming • Current Conditions and Sun & Air tiles: feels like, wind compass and gusts, pressure, humidity and dew point, UV index, air quality (US and EU AQI), visibility, sunrise and sunset • Activities: running, drying laundry and sun protection • Meteocons weather icons, with day and night versions Units: • Every value in metric and imperial units side by side • Tap a value to swap which unit comes first Weather data and alerts: • Weather from Open-Meteo (default, no API key needed) or Pirate Weather (with your own API key) • Weather alerts from 7 sources: NWS, NHC, MeteoAlarm, JMA, ECCC, BOM and GDACS. You can turn off each source • Pull down to refresh. The app also refreshes automatically when the data is old Places: • Search by city, postal code, coordinates or Plus Code • Save favorites and swipe between them • Location details card with the coordinates and the Plus Code Languages and display: • 8 languages: Malagasy, Arabic, English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Nepali and Chinese. Tap the flag to change the language • Local digits for Arabic, Hindi and Nepali • Right-to-left layout for Arabic • 22 font pairs to choose from • Share any card as an image • Help and About pages Widgets: • Two home-screen widgets: compact (4x1) and detailed (4x2) Privacy: • Your location is used only to get the weather • No account, no ads, no tracking • No personal data collected • Free software (GNU GPL v3 or later)
